messages.subject: Error message with gdistsamp
parts:

I am currently changing my analysis from distsamp to gdistsamp. I have already created the unmarkedFrameGDS and am now creating my models with gdistsamp, but I keep getting the error (Error in a[i, ] <- tlength[i] * w : number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length).

Any help interpreting this error message would be extremely helpful!
